description: Réseau cyclable is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mairie de Cannes. Ce jeu de données est lié à la visualisation suivante: Visualisation - Réseau cyclable Réseau cyclable existant sur le territoire cannois. Ce réseau comprend les pistes et bandes cyclables, ainsi que les axes de circulation dont la vitesse est limitée, favorisant ainsi les déplacements en mode doux. Coverage: Mairie de Cannes. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Mairie de Cannes. Its keywords include mobilite-transports, mode-doux, reseau, cyclable, deplacement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
